hook.text: Every support call a human handles costs about seven dollars, and callers wait four minutes to be told to check the serial number. Meet Nora.

save.text: Warranty verified, technician booked, part pre-ordered. Zero hold time, one dollar eighteen a call.

xfer.text: And when a customer is upset, Nora doesn't argue — it hands them to a human, with the full story.

cta.text: Want this on your support line? Let's build it.

call1.speaker: alex
call1.text: Thanks for calling NordFrost support, this is Nora. What's going on with your appliance?

call1.speaker: caller
call1.text: My fridge is warm but the freezer's fine. It's an RF28, serial four-four-seven-one.

call1.speaker: alex
call1.text: Found it — still in warranty. A warm fridge with a cold freezer is usually the evaporator fan, so this needs a technician.

call1.speaker: alex
call1.text: A tech can be there Thursday, nine to eleven, with the fan already on the truck — does that work?

call2.speaker: caller
call2.text: This is the third time I'm calling about this washer. It's still leaking and I'm done.

call2.speaker: alex
call2.text: I'm sorry, Gerald — that's not acceptable. I'm connecting you to Lena, a senior agent, right now; she already has your full history.
